WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM group_rates
  WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(gr.rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(gr.rate - b.avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM group_rates AS gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate
